title: Country Jam Night @ Guitars & Cadillacs
event_description: A monthly open jam for musicians and singers on KC's biggest stage at a historic country dance hall. DJ sets fill the breaks and the dance floor stays open.
event_venue_information:
Guitars & Cadillacs

Guitars & Cadillacs is Kansas City's original live country music venue and dance hall. It sits at 7312 W 119th Street in Overland Park Kansas and pairs a rockin roadhouse atmosphere with a big stage a wide dance floor and comfort food. The brand dates back to 1988 and 2026 marks the 38th anniversary of the first Guitars & Cadillacs location.

History and Legacy

The original Guitars & Cadillacs earned a name as a stop for major country acts and has hosted stars such as Garth Brooks Sawyer Brown Vince Gill Brooks & Dunn Patty Loveless and Shania Twain. The revived brand now runs two rooms: the Kansas City area club in Overland Park and a sister venue in Ralston Nebraska near Omaha. That heritage gives the stage a reputation that local players are proud to step onto.

Atmosphere and Setting

Expect a lively high energy honky-tonk built for dancing. The dance floor stays busy and the crowd ranges from first-time two-steppers to seasoned regulars in boots and hats. Smith Hat Co. runs a hat bar inside the venue so guests can pick up authentic cowboy and cowgirl gear on the spot. Comfort food and drinks keep the party going through the night.

Country Jam Night

The centerpiece for musicians is Country Jam Night held on the first Sunday of the month. Doors open at 6:00 PM and the music starts at 6:30 PM with the event wrapping up around 10:00 PM. The night is billed as an open jam where musicians and singers can take what the venue calls KC's biggest and hottest stage. DJ entertainment fills the gaps between sets and the dance floor stays open for anyone who wants to move. Organizers advise players to bring an instrument or just bring the energy and note that spots fill up fast so arriving early is smart.

Live Music Calendar

Beyond the jam the venue books live country music most nights with a mix of local and regional artists and national touring acts. Recent listings have included acts such as Tate Stevens Fatt Rascals Chase Stetson and Dylan Gerard on weekend dates. Friday and Saturday nights run until 2:00 AM while Tuesday through Thursday nights close at midnight.

Dance Lessons and Themed Nights

Free country two-step and line dance lessons run Wednesday through Friday from about 6:15 to 8:00 PM which makes the club very approachable for newcomers. Themed nights include Boot Scootin Boogie Tito's Thirsty Thursdays Fireball Friday and weekend party nights. Karaoke and DJ dance nights round out the schedule and the space is also available for private events. The venue is closed to the public on Mondays.

For Performers

Musicians who want to sit in should watch the venue's social channels for the monthly jam details and arrive early since stage time goes quickly. A pro-level stage and sound make this one of the most exciting places in the metro to play country and roots material. Cover and age requirements vary by night with typical covers between $5 and $25 so check the calendar before you go.

Good to Know

Guitars & Cadillacs is at 7312 W 119th Street in Overland Park Kansas 66213 and can be reached at (913) 413-0077 or info@guitarsandcadillacs.com. Doors generally open at 6:00 PM.
